tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the complete Watermelon UI catalog across components, animated components, blocks, dashboards, and templates.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get a Watermelon entry with preview, dependencies, install command, and source files when an installable registry item is available.

tools.name: get_inspiration
tools.description: Return 3-6 visually relevant Watermelon UI options for a design goal before choosing an implementation.

tools.name: compose_page
tools.description: Create a source-backed page plan by selecting compatible Watermelon blocks for each requested section.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Watermelon UI categories and accurate entry counts, optionally for one catalog kind.

tools.name: catalog_summary
tools.description: Return top-level Watermelon catalog counts across content types.

tools.name: list_catalog_entries
tools.description: Compatibility alias for listing Watermelon entries by kind.

tools.name: get_catalog_entry
tools.description: Compatibility alias for getting one Watermelon entry by kind and slug.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
